title: Extract Engram context-nudge lifecycle from oversized adapter modules
outcome: The cut-B change adds context-nudge and obligation-waiver state machines to already oversized production and test modules. Extract cohesive context/waiver protocol, validation, lifecycle fencing, and focused tests into dedicated module boundaries while preserving behavior and avoiding duplication of generation and reset invariants.
acceptance: Production context/waiver ownership is documented in focused modules; related tests are split along the same seams; no behavior or wire contract changes; full Rust and UI gates pass.
